451815.findings: Two large volumes, 'The Jubilee History of Tasmania' gilt on red pebble-grain cloth/morocco-style boards with gilt fillets and corner rules, raised bands and gilt panelled spines. Spine of right volume crop reads '...HISTORY / [TASMA]NIA', volume 'I.' and '[ILLUSTR]ATED' at the tail; left spine too worn/angled to read the label. This is the 1887-1890 Jubilee History of Tasmania, Illustrated (Melbourne, Wells and Leavitt), a 19th-century Tasmaniana subscription work in two volumes, in the deluxe gilt binding. Complete pair claimed (Vol 1 and 2); title pages and plates not shown, so completeness unverified.

451815.reason: 19th-century Tasmaniana, two-volume Jubilee History of Tasmania in deluxe gilt binding, sells for hundreds.

451932.condition: Appears clean behind glass; timber frame with gilt slip; no visible foxing.
